ctx.title: Box Office: Avengers Movie Series Set To Hit The 1000 Crore Net Milestone In India With Avengers: Doomsday!
ctx.summary:
With four movies, the Avengers series has gone past the 700 crore mark at the Indian box office in net collections. 
 The post  Box Office: Avengers Movie Series Set To Hit The 1000 Crore Net Milestone In India With Avengers: Doomsday!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
The Avengers movie series has been among the biggest Hollywood draws in Indian theatres, and its next chapter could reach a major milestone in the country. With four films released so far, the series has collected 725 crore+ net at the Indian box office, and the 1000 crore net mark is now in sight with Avengers: Doomsday. Keep reading for a detailed report!
Across its four releases, the Avengers series has built up a total of 729.65 crore net in India. It started with The Avengers, which earned 53 crore net. It was followed by Avengers: Age Of Ultron with 76 crore net. Avengers: Infinity War amassed 227.43 crore net. The previous film, Avengers: Endgame, earned 373.22 crore net.
With a cumulative collection of 729.65 crore net, the Avengers movie series needs 270.35 crore more to reach 1000 crore net, a number that Avengers: Doomsday is likely to achieve.
Here’s how each Avengers film performed at the Indian box office (net):
The growth across the four films tells its own story. The first two films collected 129 crore net between them, but the numbers took a big leap with Infinity War, which crossed the 200 crore mark, and then with Endgame, which went on to become the series’ biggest earner by a wide margin.
Avengers: Doomsday is enjoying enormous buzz ahead of its release, and the film is widely expected to take the movie series to the 1000 crore net club. To do that, it will need to collect 270.35 crore net in India, which is roughly 72% of what Avengers: Endgame earned.
That is a big target, but it looks achievable. Endgame set the benchmark for the series, and Infinity War also showed how strongly Indian audiences turn up for these films. If Doomsday lives up to the hype and delivers a strong opening along with solid legs, the series could well complete the 1000 crore journey. In fact, with the upcoming biggie, the movie series can also reach 1100 crore, 1200 crore, and many more milestones.
